threads.body:
If I understood the branch protection right the prefix is supposed to be the author's username.
Is `otelbot` the bot's username?
~~On https://github.com/open-telemetry/semantic-conventions-conformance/pull/255/changes/10b2c0cad3f44a8a21c8308f029166a24dbc7d27 we see `otelbot-semconv-conformance[bot]`, will that work with the branch protection?~~
On https://github.com/open-telemetry/semantic-conventions-conformance/actions/runs/37100341328/job/111138464463 we see that `otelbot` is only used if `USE_OTELBOT=true` is used, but it is false.
threads.hunk:
@@ -20,7 +20,7 @@ jobs:
     name: Build
     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
     env:
-      REPORT_BRANCH: chore/conformance-report
+      REPORT_BRANCH: otelbot/conformance-report

replies.body: thanks, I hadn't noticed that otelbot wasn't being used, and now I see that this workflow reads `OTELBOT_SEMANTIC_CONVENTIONS_CONFORMANCE_*`, but the app is actually configured as `OTELBOT_SEMCONV_CONFORMANCE_*` (according to renovate-data-autofix.yml), so I fixed the variable names and the commit identity
